title: Useful
body: Would be helpful if time based goals worked to a week or month as well as a day I.e I want to read for 1hr a week, can only currently account for a per day time, also quitting vs building habits goals i.e I want to run 5 times per week (or 20 times this month) is a building goal, or i want to limit myself to 5 beers this week (or maybe 20 a month) as a quitting goal, but I want to track it over a week or a month, not just a day. I don’t want the counter to always reset at midnight. Hope that makes sense.
author: Robbiekrnz
